description: Angular component template for the Scada Symbol Editor in the Thingsboard UI, including SVG/XML editing, zoom controls, visibility toggles, and action buttons.

methods.name: zoomIn
methods.description: Increases the zoom level of the SVG diagram.

methods.name: zoomOut
methods.description: Decreases the zoom level of the SVG diagram.

methods.name: toggleShowHidden
methods.description: Toggles visibility of hidden elements in the SVG diagram.
